control.name: CONTROL — provenance history judging disabled (every commit after the PASS is skipped, so a later FAIL deleted by a worker flips)

mutations.name: every-base rule restored (a criss-cross merge whose branch side made no net change is judged — the #4466 false positive)
any merge base accepted unconditionally (a criss-cross merge that drops a later FAIL from the other side is not judged)
pure some-base rule (a merge that keeps the side equal to one base and drops the other side's change is not judged)
equal-Evidence guard lost: the kept side's base test runs only when the other side's fails, so with equal Evidence a base matching both reads as the other side bringing nothing
octopus merge compared on its first two parents only (a later FAIL carried by a third parent and dropped by the merge is not judged)
refusal names the PASS commit instead of the judged one (the refusal class holds, the refused commit does not)
